text_block_list.text:
Finally having a day to relax, I head to the
shopping mall to do some
browsing.

Hm... There are a plethora of treatment
oils here, but they're all
glorified cooking
oils that emphasize fragrance over quality.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
In that case, perhaps the baobab seed oil
from earlier will do... But in
terms of
permeability, it lacks the right ingredients.
Hmph...
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text: T-Тренер?!
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
What are you doing he—what am I saying?
You're obviously
shopping. Still, this is
quite the coincidence.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
I was comparing the various hair oils here.
I'm just about out of my
current supply.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
I figured I would check if anything new was
available. Even for the
same products,
ingredients are often changed to suit the
latest
research.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ
choice_data_list: You sure put a lot of thought into it, huh?

text_block_list.text:
I suppose... But as you see, hair care is an
unceasing struggle for me.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
Come on, just look at it. My hair is... well,
it tends to become rather
frizzled.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
Her hair does seem a little frizzy, but it
doesn't look all that terrible
to be
concerned about.

You don't... You surely don't believe my
hair is naturally like this?
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
This is the result of a maximum amount of
effort. Each day, I style it to
minimize split
ends, and my nighttime routine is far more
complicated
than average.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
But... It's still not enough. My hair, it
won't...
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
It's a shaggy mess of knots! Even my stylist
admitted defeat against
my hyper tangles!
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
Yes. It's not the exact definition, but I'm
left with no choice but to
call it that. My
hair is an anomaly!
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
I use off-the-shelf products as well as ones
of my own making. I even
tried an
unnatural concoction of Tachyon's, but to
no avail!
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ
choice_data_list:
(Woah! Who is this, and what has she done to
Hayahide?!)

text_block_list.text:
My agony begins the moment I wake up in
the morning. Have you
ever jumped out of
bed choking on your own hair?
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text: The rainy season is especially problematic! Dealing with my hair has never been a source of joy. It is, rather, my mortal enemy.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
And people tell me to just cut it short. But
that would be the worst
move to make! My
face would look as big as a race track!
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
It's not that I prefer it long, but that's the
bitter decision I made after
considering
the advantages of either letting it hang or
tying it up. But
of course...
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
The frazzled genius continues airing her
hair grievances for some
time...
Sigh... How many times I've wished to have straight hair like Brian's.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
I remember the shock when I first braided
her hair when we were
children. The silky
touch as I ran my fingers through it... I
screamed,
"How can our hair be so
different?!"
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
I even tried holding my hair down with our
father's pomade... But of
course, it would
never feel silky like Brian's that way. It was
hopeless.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
I picture how adorable she must have been
glopping pomade on her
hair, and I can't
hold in my smile.

Wha... Are you laughing?! I'm pouring my
heart out here!
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ
choice_data_list:
Ah, I was just thinking about how you always
give it your all.

text_block_list.text:
Um, excuse me, miss? You seem to be
having trouble deciding. Is
there anything I
can help you with?
text_block_list.name: Store Clerk

text_block_list.text:
Apologies for overhearing, but I
understand that you're having some

trouble with your hair. Perhaps I could
recommend our—
text_block_list.name: Store Clerk

text_block_list.text: N-No, I'm fine... Thank you anyway.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text: Let's take our leave now.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
I, um, apologize for earlier. I become
somewhat... animated when it
comes to
hair.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
But shouting in a public space like that
without an ounce of
self-control... I
must've looked pathetic.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text: What?
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
I tell her just how incredible I think she is.
How she always strives to
improve herself,
and how she always puts her whole heart
into a
challenge.

You praise me too much... I'm simply
figuring out my problems
through trial and
error. If my hair was any good to begin
with, I
would've never put the effort in.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ
choice_data_list: But all that effort made you who you are today.

text_block_list.text:
That's... possible, I suppose. From all the
anguish my hair gave me, I
may have
gained the determination never to give in.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ
choice_data_list: Then maybe it wasn't all that bad, right?

text_block_list.text:
But... that's a matter of hindsight. Let's not
make light of the suffering
I went through
all that time.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
I swear... your interpretation of the data is
truly unique. Not at all like
mine. But that's
why I like talking with you.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
I think my words have begun to sink in, as I
see her expression soften.
In that case...
choice_data_list:
Anyway, I think your hair is fluffy and
wonderful.

text_block_list.text: I simply tell her my honest opinion, but...

Let me stop you right there. That is one
comment I cannot overlook.
Though I do
appreciate your opinion and kind words.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
However, if that's the conclusion you drew
from our conversation just
now, I must say
that your reasoning is flawed.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
There is a need to deliberate once more
about this matter.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
There's no backing out now. As my trainer,
you must understand the
pain I go through
as much as I do.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text: Now, get comfortable. It's time I told you my tragic life story. No objections.
text_block_list.name: Бива Хаяхидэ

text_block_list.text:
We go to a cafe, and I try as hard as I can
to listen to Hayahide's
passion-fueled
Theory of Frizzy Hair. Now I truly
understand how she
feels... I think.
